notes: A brake drill that actually works on a circuit: the first corner you brake for sets the target and every lap after is scored in metres. "Brake to mark" needed a standing stop, which is why no drill ever seemed to fire, and a drill left armed no longer makes that window deaf to the next one. "You alright?" only when the car really stopped, not when you ran wide. A recorded session with no clips keeps its file instead of vanishing. Plus all of 0.9.146.
